decision: PASS static focused CI regression recipe, with explicit skipped-coverage accounting boundary
limits: Bare argv recipe does not encode source HEAD/cleanliness, held socket lease, live NUMA placement, full-tree RSS/time watchdog or storage cap. Those remain separately enforced by the reviewed root V6 launch packet.

Pytest exit0 permits skipped cases. V1 records skips but does not fail for them; unexpected skips must be reported as incomplete coverage, not complete all-selected-test success. A zero-skip gate would need an explicit final check.

Selected tests may call real compiler/verifier/version commands and existing fixture helpers during guarded execution. A green CI result does not replace per-profile cold proof/task/runtime audits or admit caller/scientific claims.
Linux fixture host handling inside tests does not establish the outer actual kernel socket lease; root V6 supplies that separate exclusion.
reviewed_guards: Root argv invokes exact swdb-test interpreter with -I -B and -X fresh cache prefix before Python startup; source code asserts isolated/nonoptimized/no-bytecode flags, expected working checkout path and8GiB marker.
Python, Clang wrapper and CBMC physical hashes match the fresh reviewed metadata. SWDB_CLANG/SWDB_CBMC use exact paths.
Spawned Python processes receive PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1, PYTHONSAFEPATH=1, exact selected project PYTHONPATH, fresh PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX and PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1; pytest plugin autoload disabled.

In-process pytest has only selected project/tests inserted in sys.path, no xdist/parallel flags. Existing project addopts disables cache and excludes whole_store; none of the eight selected sources carries that marker.
Six affected vector modules, complete bounded-initialization module and one exact existing safe-both-forms CBMC test are selected. No full catalog/full suite is requested.
Arguments/progress/final census/JUnit persist under raw. Pytest exit status is propagated; empty status0 selection and created bytecode cache are refused.
Census records skipped names separately; recipe labels result focused regression evidence only, not whole ticket or scientific proof acceptance.
